title: Village & Pillage With a Tongue!
body:
Welcome to my first project! This texture pack changes villagers, pillagers, etc. noses to tongues. This pack makes villagers, pillagers, etc. very funny. Supported versions from 1.14.0 through 1.18.2 java edition ONLY.

How to install: you must download this resourse pack and open the folder C:\Users\YourName\AppData\Roaming\.minecraft\resourcepacks,

Separate folder: C:\Users\YourName\AppData\Roaming\.minecraft\instances\MinecraftInstallationName\resourcepacks

Thanks for downloading!
